content:
maria: Quick check 1 - we're iterating on the compact form rows in the Routes editor. Two options: show errors inline next to fields, or collapse them into a single top-level summary. Which wins for discoverability + minimal noise? Screenshot: https://img.example/route-rows-compact-v2.png alex: inline is more discoverable for single-field mistakes. summary is better when you have many tiny problems. How about hybrid: inline for single/first error, otherwise summary? jess: hybrid makes sense. Concrete: on submit, if errors <=2 show inline; if >2 show condensed summary pill with count and a flyout listing errors. dinesh: a11y: whichever we pick, ensure focus management. If we show summary, focus should move to the summary and it should be keyboard operable to jump to the first invalid field. For inline errors, they need aria-describedby and role="alert" on error containers. sam: required-field markers 1 - we currently use a visual asterisk. Accessibility asked for visible label like "(required)" in the legend too. Any compromise? maria: proposal: keep asterisk visually, add an accessible label on the form legend that reads "Fields marked * are required" and include hidden text per control: required. That keeps visual density. jess: also set aria-required="true" on required inputs. And don't rely on color alone 1 add a small icon next to the inline error. aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: - Move focus to error summary on submit when present - Use aria-describedby to associate inputs and errors - Announce error count when summary receives focus - Visible text preferred for required fields; sr-only okay if legend clarifies alex: another topic: delete flow in the table. Product wants more guardrails for shared routes. Ideas: typed confirm (enter route), confirm checkbox + secondary action, or immediate delete with undo toast. dinesh: Typed confirm is best for cross-service deletes. For quick personal deletes, undo toast + short delay is less disruptive. Can gate typed-confirm by dependent services count > 1. sam: copy attempt for typed modal: "Delete route \"/checkout\" from all services. This cannot be undone. To confirm, type /checkout." Primary action: "Delete route" (red). jess: shorten primary to "Delete permanently" maybe. And place the route path in bold above so typing is obvious. maria: UX decision proposal: if dependent_services_count > 1 then typed-confirm; else checkbox + red delete + undo toast. Also surface number of affected services in modal. dinesh: dev note: validate typed-confirm on server too. Add aria-live region for input validation. Also rate-limit accidental rapid deletions. aria-bot: ARIA snippet to reuse: ```

Delete route

This will remove /checkout from X services. Type the route to confirm.

``` maria: back to errors UX: what about summary pill copy? Ideas: "3 problems 1 view" vs "3 errors 1 details". Also need quick-jump in the flyout. jess: "3 issues — view" is less scary than "errors". Show up to 5 items in the flyout with anchor links that focus the field. If more than 5, show a link to expand to full summary area. alex: engineering: client should compute errors on submit for instant feedback; server may return field-level errors too. If server returns global errors, show them at top of summary pill. Avoid extra round trips just to populate the flyout. sam: action items: 1) design to produce two mocks: inline-first and summary-first/flyout; 2) copy doc for delete modal variations; 3) accessibility checklist to include focus rules and aria attributes; 4) eng to add typed-confirm feature gated by dependent-services count and server-side validation. maria: I'll sketch both mocks in Figma and attach notes for aria and copy. Will ping channel when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: dinesh: will test prototypes with VoiceOver/NVDA once available. jess: I'll QA copy and microcopy tone. sam: great.
